package.description: The World-class Authoring Tool for eLearning Design

en-US.description: The World-class Authoring Tool for eLearning Design
en-US.longDescription: ActivePresenter is a world-class eLearning authoring tool designed for creating professional, interactive content with ease. It supports a range of functionalities, including converting PowerPoint presentations into HTML5 or eLearning formats, building interactive simulations with smart screen-capture technology, and developing assessments or gamified educational experiences without requiring coding skills. The software also offers powerful video recording and editing tools, along with responsive design support for various screen sizes. With its user-friendly interface, ActivePresenter is perfect for creating slide-based courses, interactive simulations, and video-based lessons across different devices, making it a versatile choice for educators and professionals alike.
en-US.name: ActivePresenter

zh-CN.description: 世界一流的电子教学设计制作工具
zh-CN.longDescription: ActivePresenter 是一款世界级的电子教学制作工具，专为轻松创建专业的交互式内容而设计。它支持一系列功能，包括将 PowerPoint 演示文稿转换为 HTML5 或电子学习格式，利用智能屏幕捕捉技术构建交互式模拟，以及开发评估或游戏化教育体验，而无需编码技能。该软件还提供功能强大的视频录制和编辑工具，以及针对各种屏幕尺寸的响应式设计支持。ActivePresenter 具有友好的用户界面，非常适合创建基于幻灯片的课程、交互式模拟以及跨不同设备的基于视频的课程，是教育工作者和专业人士的多功能选择。
